name: std::chrono::month_weekday_last::month_weekday_last

declarations.code:
constexpr month_weekday_last(const std::chrono::month &m,

    const std::chrono::weekday_last &wdl) noexcept;

intro: Constructs a month_weekday_last object that stores the month m and the weekday_last wdl.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A more convenient way to construct a month_weekday_last is with operator/, e.g., std::chrono::April/std::chrono::Sunday[std::chrono::last].

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent a valid calendar component or date in March 2024, then convert it to text.
